QuestInfo.name: Cygnus Constellation
QuestInfo.0: Empress Cygnus would like to give you a special medal for reaching Lv. 200.
QuestInfo.1: Empress Cygnus would like to give you a special medal for reaching Lv. 200. Head for #bEreve#k.
QuestInfo.2: Empress Cygnus gave you the <Cygnus Constellation> medal for reaching Lv. 200.
QuestInfo.summary: Go to Ereve and meet the Empress.

0.0: Shinsoo has temporarily left Ereve to search Maple World. She has told me of your exploits and of how strong you have become, #b#h0##k. I would like to give you a #bspecial Medal#k.\r\nCome find me in #bEreve#k.\r\n

no.0: As you wish. Visit me in #bEreve#k if you change your mind.

1.0: Welcome back, #b#h0##k. \r\nI still remember your first day in #bEreve#k... Kiku was teaching you the proper way to hold a sword. And now, you are on par with my chief knights, #bMihile, Oz, Irena, Eckhart, and Hawkeye#k!
1.1: Shinsoo and I are in agreement. You are our sixth #bchief knight#k, #b#h0##k.

yes.0: You are a star in this world of darkness. When the sun shines, the stars hide, unneeded. But when darkness blooms, as it does now with the threat of the Black Mage, the stars become our guide.
yes.1: Maple World needs more knights like you, #b#h0##k.
yes.2: Visit me now and again, #b#h0##k. \r\nWith #bShinsoo#k away, this place feels so lonely...
